planned_arguments.prompt:
Create one finished flat opaque landscape 16:9 civic cultural-event poster for subway-station and community digital screens. Use case: ads-marketing. This is one independent poster, fully composed to its landscape canvas, with no mockup, border frame, contact sheet, comparison panels or extra image.

Visual system: a precise shallow-oblique overhead editorial drawing of neighbors gathered for an outdoor short-film screening and a director conversation under a bridge. Sunny ochre paving is the continuous ground; deep cobalt is the principal drawing and type color, with a few warm red clothing/mat accents and a pale illuminated screen. Broad clean matte silhouettes, purposeful joints and clean edges; approachable adult cultural-event tone, not children's cartoon figures or toy objects. The diagram's warm daylight palette is an explanation of the evening gathering.

First construct a large connected horseshoe of about 16 distinct seated adult neighbors on individual rectangular mats, filling most of the middle 60% of the canvas. Show complete coherent adult bodies with heads, torsos, arms and folded legs, varied relaxed poses, distinct mats, and feet/arms correctly contacting their own mats. In this overhead view the broad horseshoe wraps across the upper middle and down both sides, with its lower ends left open toward the bottom of the poster. Keep an open central aisle about 40% of canvas width. Do not arrange people as a rigid icon grid. Orient the audience coherently toward the screen along the upper-right shoulder. A broad freestanding projection panel at approximately x78–95%, y28–48% has an unmistakably visible bright front face, clear cobalt frame and stable supporting feet; show a simple cinematic illuminated landscape on its face, with absolutely no writing. Near its lower-left side draw a standing adult director holding a visible microphone and two listening adults visibly turned toward that speaker; their relation must read as a conversation. A broad muted darker-ochre bridge-cast shadow crosses the paving diagonally and extends beyond the canvas, without covering or reducing copy contrast. A few sparse paving joints establish the outdoor ground. The gathering itself is the substantial subject, not a decorative tiny motif.

Reading and text relationships: largest practical group is the date and time on flat empty central floor at x29–69%, y43–63%, surrounded by the horseshoe but never touched by bodies or mats. Invitation/identity at x4–43%, y6–24%, outside the seating arc. Activity and venue at x50–96%, y7–24%, beside and above the screen. Practical text occupies the open lower ends, left at x4–47%, y78–94% and right at x57–96%, y78–94%, with the two ends aligned and ample separation between lines. All copy horizontal, using strong, clean, fully formed Korean/Latin sans letterforms; never perspective-transform, curve, distort or merge letters. At an image width of 720 pixels use roughly 31 px Korean title, 18 px English identity, 32 px date, 35 px time, and at least 17 px for descriptor, venue and all four practical entries. Use deliberate word spacing and open Hangul counters. Keep every practical entry plainly readable at width 720, strong cobalt-on-ochre contrast, no tiny secondary copy. The date/time and audience form the first gaze, then the screen and place/activity, then the useful attendance instructions.

Print ONLY the following ten entries, exactly once each, verbatim with intact word spaces, punctuation and case. These are the actual copy, not labels:
Upper-left, Korean title above English:
다리 아래 영화관
BRIDGE CINEMA

Upper-right, activity above venue; the descriptor can soft-wrap at its middle dot if necessary:
야외 단편 상영 · 감독과의 대화
홍제천 연가교 아래

Central aisle, date above time:
2026.12.05 토요일
18:00–20:30

Lower-left, two separate readable lines:
17:30부터 입장
무료 관람 · 선착순 80명

Lower-right, two separate readable lines:
돗자리 지참
우천 시 실내로 변경

No added words, labels, numerals, logos, roster names, pseudo-print, credits, watermark or QR. No invented event details. No reference-poster copy. Maintain the large overhead horseshoe, illuminated visible screen face, director/listener interaction and clean open text zones as one complete visual system. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

maintained_features: overhead open horseshoe of adult neighbors on mats
illuminated screen face and director-listener interaction
